novel_features.name: SNAP Signature Debugger
novel_features.description: Build and inspect both SNAP signatures locally — see the exact string-to-sign, body hash, and headers so a 403 is diagnosed in seconds instead of bisected by hand.

novel_features.name: SNAP Token Lifecycle & Keygen
novel_features.description: Check cached B2B token freshness against the 900-second TTL, and generate the RSA-2048 keypair SNAP onboarding requires with 'snap keygen'.

novel_features.name: Smart Payment Routing
novel_features.description: Charge a payment with the right API surface chosen automatically — SNAP where the method supports it, legacy otherwise, with --surface to override.

novel_features.name: Smart Payout Routing
novel_features.description: Send a disbursement via SNAP transfer-interbank or e-wallet topup with account inquiry first, falling back to legacy batch submit when asked.

novel_features.name: SNAP Response-Code Explainer
novel_features.description: Decode any SNAP response code offline — meaning, originating service, HTTP status, and the likely fix.

novel_features.name: Sandbox Simulation Helper
novel_features.description: Print the exact sandbox magic values (even/odd account numbers, magic amounts) that force a success, pending, or failure outcome.

novel_features.name: Order/Payment Reconciliation
novel_features.description: Join synced orders against payments locally to flag charged-but-unsettled orders, payments with no order, and amount mismatches.

novel_features.name: Refund Audit
novel_features.description: Flag refunds that exceed their source payment, target unsettled payments, or duplicate an earlier refund.

novel_features.name: Stuck-Disbursement Detector
novel_features.description: List disbursements still pending past a chosen age, bucketed against Durianpay's 2/5/10/90/210-minute webhook retry ladder.

novel_features.name: Completion-Signature Verifier
novel_features.description: Recompute the HMAC-SHA256(disbursement_id|amount) completion signature locally and compare it to the webhook's value.
